title: HOW LOWE'S WARRANTY PROTECTION PLAN WORKS. SHOULD YOU BUY A WARRANTY ON YOUR APPLIANCES OR NOT?
channel: Gary Lee Stanley Your Sales Guy
summary: A Lowe's appliance sales rep pitches Lowe's 3- and 5-year appliance protection plans as covering repairs beyond the 1-year manufacturer warranty, with a lemon-replacement clause and small annual perks.

verdicts.note: True by design; appliance manufacturer warranties are typically about a year, and paid plans add service years, though value still depends on failure-rate base rates.

assertions.quote: it's like getting your your your service for free

verdicts.note: Modest annual perk allowances rarely offset a plan's full price; this is a sales exaggeration rather than a typical financial outcome.
Many major appliance repairs do run in that range, but not all failures are expensive, and some units are cheaper to replace than repair.

assertions.quote: a one-year manufacturers warranty for parts and labor
